answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh anchor challenge every epoch. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its tundra from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the karst behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal c6cyn.
